notes.title: “It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us”
notes.intro: Apostles and elders meet in Jerusalem to decide whether Gentile believers must keep the law of Moses.

views.label: A model for councils of bishops with authority
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians see this as the first church council, a model for later councils guided by the Holy Spirit.
views.source: Catechism of the Catholic Church 884; Orthodox teaching on conciliarity

views.label: A model for church assemblies under Scripture
views.summary: Presbyterians see here elders meeting together in a representative assembly; others see a whole church seeking the Spirit together.

views.label: A local church seeking unity together
views.summary: Congregational traditions emphasise that “the whole church” agreed (v. 22), and Quakers see a model for discerning God’s will in unity.
